browser_export_qualification: Actual export fetch and actual same-origin Blob download are separate. Observed response-body cache bytes are retained even when zero. A zero cache is qualified only by exact completed error-free export fetch/Content-Length plus complete matching Blob download and manual raw/profile oracle; no network body completeness or UI SHA verification is claimed.
qualification: Eight API reference profiles plus eight real UI reproduction crawls on one owned eight-page loopback fixture. No full Screaming Frog parity or Source17 acceptance/install claim. Raw snapshots and child-only frontier URLs are independently checked. Root common-window authority is external and retained until it validates actual drain.

limitations: Import does not start a crawl, follow links, evaluate formulas or fetch sitemap indexes.
Only absolute HTTP/HTTPS values are URL candidates; original values and duplicate rows are retained.
Independent import contract; complete original parser/filter parity is NOT_PROVEN.
